name: The Vitrified Slag Chasm
core_rationale: Uncharted northern glass-slag gorge of Kilnfire Terraces where over-fired porcelain magma from the Great Lantern Eclipse cooled into singing crystal bridges.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Superheated porcelain glaze-steam billows from the northern Slag Chasm; the Guild of Potters has sealed the bridge until the Great Damper is cooled.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Iridescent cobalt-glass arches rising out of shimmering white steam.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient kiln-spirit is singing beneath the vitrified glass bridges?

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors the northern [1, 0] cell of district-kilnfire-terraces and links to Cinder Apron's North portal.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Singing cobalt-glass bridges suspended above a steaming porcelain gorge.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: 3D terrain tile not yet compiled.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: monster spawn table deferred until Great Damper chapter.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserved as intentional Fog of Lore with a locked North boundary portal on Cinder Apron.
